blurb: Rainhard Brewing Co. brews hand crafted beers with a hands-on approach, focusing on quality and experimentation. The brewery is located in a renovated 1940's manufacturing plant with a bar surrounded by brewing vessels. They offer a variety of beers including IPAs and barrel-aged stouts, and have indoor and outdoor dining with a new patio.
